sources.title: AP-10K: A Benchmark for Animal Pose Estimation in the Wild

sources.title: AP-10K: A Benchmark for Animal Pose Estimation in the Wild
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose AP-10K, the first large-scale benchmark for general animal pose estimation, to facilitate the research in animal pose estimation. AP-10K consists of 10,015 images collected and filtered from 23 animal families and 60 species following the taxonomic rank and high-quality keypoint annotations labeled and checked manually.
